svg.title: AstralBeam symbol
svg.desc: Two linked orbit rings crossed by a slanted beam of light.
svg.metadata: AstralBeam symbol construction: - Intent: two orbit rings (the a/b bowls) drawn as one continuous strip, with a tapered shaft of light crossing their shared waist. - Reusable ids: #astralbeam-mark, #astralbeam-rings, and #astralbeam-beam. - Design grid: rings are stroked ellipses (centerline rx 30 / ry 34, stroke 12) centered at x = -31 and x = +31. Their centerlines have a 2-unit gap while their outer contours overlap by 10 units, preserving the brush-like handoff between the two rings. - The beam is an 11-unit-wide spindle rotated 15.85 degrees across the shared waist. Its straight edges are tangent to both inner ring ellipses (rx 24 / ry 28), and its 49-unit half-length projects to a 7.1-unit vertical overhang beyond the outer rings. - Keep logo colors aligned with the theme values in packages/ui/src/styles.css: rings use currentColor (default: light theme foreground), and the beam uses --astralbeam-primary with the light theme primary as its fallback. - The default color #07191d is the sRGB hex of --foreground oklch(0.200064 0.025239 213.919); the beam fill #0c7a69 is the sRGB hex of --primary oklch(0.519852 0.092904 178.167). - The PNG exporter (librsvg) cannot parse oklch(), so the hex values are embedded. If either theme token changes, recompute its sRGB hex.
